name: Tabetha
summary: At her farmstead deep in the Quagmire, Tabetha teaches aspiring spellcasters and aids those seeking mastery of arcane and occult relics.

sections.title: Hermit of the Quagmire
sections.body: North of the Stonemaul Ruins, Tabetha lives in a secluded shack with her apprentices. She chose solitude over the academic hierarchies of the Eastern Kingdoms. Spellcasters cross Kalimdor's beasts and mire to seek her guidance, drawn by her mastery of the arcane.

sections.title: A Neutral Mentor
sections.body: Tabetha welcomes Alliance and Horde initiates who are willing to learn. Though human, she teaches mages and helps warlocks with dangerous bindings such as the Orb of Orahil. Her history with Menara Voidrender reaches into esoteric magic beyond faction allegiance.

faq.answer: Tabetha lives at Tabetha's Farm, in a secluded shack deep in the Quagmire of western Dustwallow Marsh, just north of the Stonemaul Ruins.

faq.q: Is Tabetha hostile to Horde players?
faq.answer: No. Though human, Tabetha is neutral. She teaches apprentices and aids spellcasters from both the Horde and the Alliance.

faq.q: Why do mages and warlocks seek her out?
faq.answer: Mages and warlocks seek Tabetha for her knowledge of arcane rituals, magical foci, and binding rites. Mages ask her about craft mastery and power trials, while warlocks seek help to cleanse or bind potent artifacts such as the Orb of Orahil.

faq.q: What is her connection to Menara Voidrender?
faq.answer: Tabetha shares a history with Menara Voidrender. Though their paths have diverged, their knowledge of powerful relics and binding magic connects them across their separate hermitages.

angles.text: As a mage, you can turn to Tabetha for guidance as you test your grasp of arcane rituals and refine your craft in dangerous lands like Uldaman.
As a warlock, you can turn to Tabetha for help with dangerous magical relics such as the Infernal Orb and the Orb of Orahil.
